# CNN-BiGRU-Attention — một model cho mọi xe

<!-- generated by scripts/experiments_status.py from scenarios.json + results.csv; do not edit -->

- **Model:** 77 × 1 → Conv64 + BN + MaxPool → Conv128 → BiGRU 64/chiều → Attention 128 → 16; 118.288 tham số, dropout 0,3.
- **Code:** core/cnn_bigru_attention.py, core/grouped_bigru.py, scripts/run_fl.py --backbone cnn-bigru-attention
- **Protocol:** 5.343 xe nhận = 5.343 client, mọi client mỗi round, 1 epoch local trên fold train + val, 50 round, batch 64, AdamW cosine 1e-3 → 1e-5; centralized 50 epoch, batch 4.096. Headline = round 50 (CANPerFL: 10 epoch fine-tune sau FedAvg r50), view theo bài gốc. [protocol](../../docs/research/protocol.md)
- **Tài liệu:** [dense-recurrent-fl](../../docs/research/backbones/dense-recurrent-fl.md), [central-backbones](../../docs/research/backbones/central-backbones.md), [rebuild](../../papers/mnkash-2026-cnn-bigru/rebuild.md)
